name: 10528 · Harrison, NY
findings: ZIP 10528 (Harrison) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10528 (Harrison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10528 (Harrison) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
